ResearchProjectDef.label: Advanced bionic replacements
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Refined artificial anatomy builds on standard bionics to improve the performance of limbs and other replacement parts.
Manufacture an ultra advanced artificial arm, further improved from the standard models. Silenced mini-servos give great strength, while the biogel nerve-link gives exquisite control. A lattice-dust healing system allows it to recover from damage. It is better than a biological arm in almost every way.

ResearchProjectDef.label: organic optimizing nanobots
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture nanomachines that develop the natural body's performance over a three-day treatment. The process requires additional rest and food; afterward, the machines dissolve without leaving a permanent artificial implant.

ResearchProjectDef.label: neuro-cure framework
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Manufacture a set of highly advanced nanomachines, synthetic brain tissue and artificial nerves capable of restoring the function of a brain. Used for curing brain injuries, dementia and alzheimer.
Requires Brain Surgery research to use.
